messages:
natalie: Quick weekly runway readout — we saw a regional divergence overnight, wanted to call out a few items before the sync. APAC spot churn spiked, eu-west has a scheduled network maintenance Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC (TOR swap). Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/net-rotations :spiral_calendar:

arjun: Can you paste the shortfall numbers? need to know if we should push dedicated capacity or tweak autoscaler.

natalie: Shortfall snapshot (last 24h):
```
region     | demand(gpu-hrs) | supply(gpu-hrs) | gap
APAC       | 980             | 740             | 240
US-West    | 720             | 700             | 20
EU-West    | 560             | 560             | 0
```
APAC nights are the main problem — spot reclaim rate jumped, causing autoscaler thrash and cold-start latency.

eva: Noticed a network issue in cluster-gamma (eu-west) that explains a lot of pod restarts: kube-proxy churn from MTU mismatch after the switch replacement test. Patch ready, need a 30-min window.

ben: Cost note: converting 8 gpus in APAC from spot -> reserved for night windows adds roughly "$4.2k/mo" but saves ~2800 cold-start tokens/day and reduces latency SLO violations by ~60%. Warm-pool pre-warm cheaper but still has provider spin-up variability.

ops-bot: [alert] cluster-beta spot reclaim rate = 18% (6h), average reclaim duration = 7m, incidents triggered = 3 :warning:

arjun: Proposal: 1) move 8 gpus to dedicated in apac-night window (00:00-06:00 JST) 2) enable warm-pool for embeddings heavy routes 3) schedule eva's MTU patch Tue 02:15-02:45 UTC to coincide with maintenance. Anyone opposed? :thinking_face:

natalie: +1 on that plan. Also let's flip routing policy for non-critical background jobs to US-West during APAC night to reduce churn. I'll open the routing change ticket.

eva: I'll take the MTU window and validate after TOR swap. Will also add a health-check that alerts before kube-proxy restarts cascade.

ben: I'll run a quick delta-cost calc and post it here by EOD. If numbers look bad we can reduce dedicated to 6 gpus and rely on warm-pool for the rest.

arjun: I'll submit infra change (PR 4827) for the dedicated pool and warm-pool toggles, assign to natalie for rollout.

natalie: Action items: 1) arjun open change + PR (assigned) 2) ben posts cost delta by EOD 3) eva schedules MTU patch Tue 02:15 4) I will update routing policy and notify partners. Ping me if anything blocks. :rocket:

ops-bot: [info] runbook link created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-night-2026-03 - created by natalie

arjun: FYI I'll throttle user-facing experiments during the night window to reduce need for capacity burst.

ben: Cost delta posted: https://redwood.internal/finance/apac-dedicated-delta (summary in PR).

natalie: Thanks all — will call out in the cadence meeting. If no objections by EOD we'll proceed with the above and post the downtime/maintenance note in #announcements. :white_check_mark:
